newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Chillers details 10.8 mln rand rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Chillers details 10.8 mln rand rights offer.

text.p: South African food business Chillers Group Ltd said on Monday that it planned to raise around 10.75 million rand prior to expenses by way of a rights offer.
Shareholders will be offered stock in the ratio of 50 new ordinary shares of 100 cents each in the capital of Chillers for every 100 shares held at a price of 100 cents per new share.
The last day to register for the offer is June 13.
Further details will be published around June 11, the firm said.
